svg.aria-label: Condition comparison: each row's shift divided by its own noise band
svg.text: Condition comparison: each row's shift divided by its own noise band
The axis is the derived signal-to-noise ratio |Δ| ÷ band (2×(CV sum)) — not a new statistic: the raw Δ% and the ±band are printed at the end of every
row and match condition-comparison.tsv. The ±1.0 line is the decision boundary: inside it (|ratio| < 1) means 'indistinguishable at n=10', which is
how each row was judged for exclusion (all 10 capabilities/shapes × 3 backends = 30 rows of this window are inside). Every number is the raw median of
the 10 timed repeats — presentation only: no smoothing, no axis truncation, no statistical transformation
